title: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sents.t: The video you're about to see was posted by Andy Winehouse, who, in the follow-up video, recorded this.
sents.zh: 接下来的视频是 Andy Winehouse 发布的，他在后续视频里录了这段话。

sents.t: Okay, for anybody asking, this is my family home.
sents.zh: 好，回答一下大家的问题：这是我家的老房子。

sents.t: I grew up here, and we've never had a single experience like this.
sents.zh: 我在这里长大，我们从来没遇到过这样的事。

sents.t: I don't know what is going on.
sents.zh: 我不知道到底是怎么回事。

sents.t: I'm getting a lot of comments saying I'm doing it for views and I'm doing it for likes, and I promise you I'm not.
sents.zh: 很多评论说我是为了流量、为了点赞，我向你们保证我不是。

sents.t: Don't like the video. Don't comment if you don't want to.
sents.zh: 不想点赞就别点，不想评论就别评论。

sents.t: I just need somebody who knows what this is. Please reach out.
sents.zh: 我只是需要一个懂这是什么的人。请联系我。

sents.t: I don't care if it's in a comment or privately. Just please reach out, and please just help me.
sents.zh: 评论也好，私信也好，我都不在乎。请联系我，求你们帮帮我。

sents.t: I don't know what to tell my wife when she gets home.
sents.zh: 我不知道我妻子回家后该怎么跟她说。

sents.t: I can't afford a hotel for the night.
sents.zh: 我住不起酒店。

sents.t: We're doing a remodel in the bathroom, and everything's just going in right now.
sents.zh: 我们正在翻修浴室，现在什么都在弄。

sents.t: And I'm not trying to be dramatic about this, but I have no idea what to do.
sents.zh: 我不是故意夸张，但我真的不知道该怎么办。

sents.t: And everybody in the comments all day has just been freaking me out, and I want to think this is just in my head.
sents.zh: 评论区的人一整天都在吓我，我也想相信这只是我自己想多了。

sents.t: But I keep listening to it over and over and over again.
sents.zh: 但我一遍又一遍地反复听。

sents.t: Somebody please, somebody please reach out with an answer or some help or something.
sents.zh: 求求谁来给我一个答案，或者帮帮我，什么都行。

sents.t: As you can tell by the video, Andy is in total shock and cannot process the strange incident that took place inside his home.
sents.zh: 从视频可以看出，Andy 完全被吓坏了，无法接受家里发生的这件怪事。

sents.t: Luckily, he was able to record this incident in case no one believed him.
sents.zh: 幸好他把这件事录了下来，以防没人相信他。

sents.t: Andy writes, "I don't know what to do at this point.
sents.zh: Andy 写道：“现在我真的不知道该怎么办了。

sents.t: Things got weird last night, and I had to sleep in my car.
sents.zh: 昨晚事情变得很诡异，我只好睡在车里。

sents.t: I am safe, but I am not doing well, and I need help."
sents.zh: 我很安全，但状态很差，我需要帮助。”

sents.t: This is what he caught.
sents.zh: 这就是他拍到的。

sents.t: Hey, come here. Come here.
sents.zh: 嘿，过来。过来。

sents.t: Andy can rest assured that he's not losing his mind, as the video shows that someone or something is mimicking his own voice.
sents.zh: Andy 可以放心，他没有疯，因为视频显示，确实有人或某种东西在模仿他的声音。

sents.t: It's up to you to decide as to whether or not something supernatural was caught on camera.
sents.zh: 镜头是否拍到了超自然的东西，由你来决定。

sents.t: Andy is certain that he did.
sents.zh: Andy 确信他拍到了。

sents.t: But for now, the video remains a mystery and is left open to interpretation.
sents.zh: 但目前，这段视频仍然是个谜，任人解读。
